title: On the Regularity and Interpolation of Coupled Cluster Amplitudes in Canonical Orbital Basis
summary: Arguably the most widely used approaches for obtaining highly accurate molecular ground-state energies are coupled cluster methods. Despite introducing two layers of approximation, a linear and a nonlinear one, coupled cluster methods remain computationally intensive, with the complexity scaling as $O(poly(N))$, where $N$ is the number of electrons. Moreover, this method must be applied over a large set of different nuclear coordinates in order to study certain chemical phenomena.
